notes: Asserts a waiting episode carried by NO tool call, and both of its edges. The dialog is a managed-settings security review raised by Claude Code's own remote-settings poll (CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SETTINGS_PATH / CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SETTINGS_POLL_MS) while the session is mid-generation with no tool open — deliberately NOT a sandbox-network or MCP-elicitation dialog, both of which fire while a tool call is in flight and so would fail the row's own acceptance criterion. The recipe spends one arming turn first (the driver has no file-writing step), so the scenario's ready->working->waiting->working->ready arc is asserted on the SECOND turn; arm_turn_start/arm_turn_end exist only as anchors for it. KNOWN FAILING on main (#1861): dialog_waiting and dialog_answered are the phases that fail. A tool-free blocking dialog raises no PermissionRequest (that event carries a tool_name and there is no tool); its only hook signal is Notification with notification_type=permission_prompt, published on a 6000 ms timer (sKe=6000 in claude 2.1.259). The daemon installs the Notification matcher as idle_prompt only (hookinstaller.go, hookMatcherNotification) AND handleNotificationHook drops every other type as defense-in-depth, so nothing is delivered and no classifier rung fires — neither the entry into waiting nor the release out of it is observable. PR #1867 (open, unmerged) widens the matcher; the handler guard must move with it. This spec asserts the CORRECT behaviour and is not weakened to match the bug. dialog_waiting pins no max_delay_ms on purpose: the signal is timer-bound at ~6 s behind the modal, and a ceiling written before that was measured on a real recording would be a guess. model is left unpinned for record to fill.

text: Session appears in ready after launch
Arming turn: the agent copies the new managed-settings file into place. Anchor only — not part of the scenario's asserted arc.

Arming turn ends at ready with no waiting episode. A waiting here means the cp was itself permission-gated and the recipe's settings blob did not take — which would inject a class-1 (tool-carried) episode and invalidate the cell.
The turn under test begins: a long, tool-free generation that keeps the session working while the settings poll fires.

THE ASSERTION UNDER TEST, first edge. The managed-settings review dialog opens with NO tool call in flight and the session must go working -> waiting. Fails on main: the only signal is Notification/permission_prompt, which the installed idle_prompt matcher never admits and the handler drops anyway (#1861).
THE ASSERTION UNDER TEST, second edge. The user answers the dialog and the session must leave waiting. Nothing carries this edge either: no tool call completes to end the episode.

Trailing idle, the load-bearing half of this row: the session stays ready for >=15 s. This is the only phase that catches a session left pinned at waiting by a dialog signal no later event retires, or falling back to waiting afterwards.
